description.title: Windows frameless shell: hide title+menu bar, custom window controls
description.description:
Product feedback 2026-07-21: On Windows remove the system title bar (min/max/close) and the menu bar (File/Edit/View/Window). Add custom min/max/close controls in the top-right of the app toolbar that look and behave like native Windows chrome, for visual unity with the app shell (counterpart to macOS SHELL-015 / Serpent-4ze).

Acceptance:
1) No system title bar and no menu bar; toolbar is flush with window edge
2) Custom minimize / maximize-restore / close in top-right; hover/active close to Win10/11 native
3) Functions work; maximize toggles restore glyph
4) Blank toolbar areas drag the window; double-click blank toolbar toggles maximize (Win convention)
5) macOS traffic lights unchanged; text edit shortcuts still work without menu bar
6) Resolves Windows half of Serpent-j5x by choosing hide menu bar (not localize Electron defaults)
